accountManagement.title: Admin accounts
accountManagement.description: Access to the platform admin panel itself - separate from all organization users.
accountManagement.newAdminModalDescription: Creates another access to the platform admin panel.

uploadPipeline.title: File pipeline
uploadPipeline.description: Where files from every upload path (protocol image, gallery, Word import, Abgabebox) currently stand - scan result and origin per file, refreshed every 15 seconds.
uploadPipeline.quarantineDescription: Files currently in quarantine waiting for the virus scan that don't have an entry in the files overview yet (that only happens after a successful scan).

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.mfaRequiredTitle: MFA is required for platform admin accounts
login.mfaRequiredDescription: {user} needs a second factor (authenticator app) before logging in.
login.confirmationCodeLabel: Confirmation code from your authenticator app

userManagement.toolbarDescription: All users across every organization. Each account belongs to exactly one organization.
userManagement.passwordHelpEdit: Only fill in to change the password. At least 12 characters.
userManagement.passwordHelpCreate: Set directly here, at least 12 characters. There is no automatic invitation email - share the password with the user separately.
userManagement.participantAutoNote: This account was created automatically from a participant. For the first login, please enable login and set a new password.
userManagement.tenantFixedHelp: An account's organization is fixed and cannot be changed.
userManagement.mergeUserDescription: The source user is merged into the target user (including role and participant links) and then deleted. Only possible within the same organization.

toasts.userListLoadFailed: User list could not be loaded
toasts.mergeConfirm: Really merge users? The source user will be permanently deleted afterwards.

fields.userLimitHelp: Empty = plan limit applies. Currently {count} user(s){suffix}

tenantModal.sideNote: The organization sees plan, modules and estimated cost under Organization settings → Plan & usage.

table.name: Name
table.empty: This organization has no users yet.

tenantModal.usersHint: Each account belongs to exactly one organization. Create new users under "Users" and pick the organization there.

cleanup.warning: This action permanently deletes data from the database - there is no undo. The organization itself, templates, form fields and user access stay in any case.
cleanup.allHint: Selects all categories below at once.
cleanup.nothingDeleted: nothing (0 matches in the selected categories)
cleanup.confirmLabel: Type the organization name to confirm: "{name}"
cleanup.confirmMessage: {count} data category/categories of "{tenant}" will be permanently deleted. Continue?

protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.description: All protocols - manually created and imported - including the Word-import queue.

list_entries.title: Data from lists
list_entries.description: All entries in all lists. The lists themselves (name, columns) remain.

lists_full.title: Lists completely
lists_full.description: Lists including their entries. Also deletes Abgabebox configurations linked to one of these lists.

todos.title: Todos
todos.description: Standalone todos. Todos tied to a protocol already disappear with "Protocols".

documents.title: Uploaded documents
documents.description: Word/PDF imports and Abgabebox uploads, including files orphaned as a result.

toasts.storageLoadFailed: Storage usage could not be loaded
toasts.imagePickInvalid: Please choose an image (PNG or JPG)
toasts.userDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete user "{name}"? The account belongs only to this organization and will be gone afterwards.

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.description: Unexpected backend errors from the whole application (hocX + Abgabebox) - regular users never see more than a generic message.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: All custom domains across every organization, with status and health check.
domains.deleteConfirmMessage: This domain will be removed from organization "{tenant}". The organization can then set up a new domain and verify it again.

sso.description: Configure external sign-in (SSO) exclusively for logging into the platform admin panel. Organization users are not affected and continue to sign in with a password.

mfa.intro: Platform admin accounts have system-wide access to every organization and therefore require a second factor. At least one factor must always remain.
mfa.mandatoryNote: MFA is mandatory for platform admin accounts.
mfa.passkeysUnavailable: No passkey support in this browser
mfa.totpDescription: A time-based code (TOTP) from an authenticator app such as Bitwarden, 1Password or Google Authenticator.
mfa.passkeyDescription: Unlock via Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key - fast and without typing a code.
mfa.noFactorsYet: No MFA factors set up yet.
mfa.lastFactorNote: The last factor can't be removed.
mfa.lastFactorTitle: Platform administrators must keep at least one MFA factor

tenants.title: Organizations
tenants.description: All organizations in the system. New organizations are created centrally here.
tenants.newTenantDescription: Creates a new organization with the default document template.
tenants.nonBookablePlansHint: Non-bookable plans (e.g. for existing organizations) can be assigned afterwards in the organization settings.
tenants.cloneDescription: Creates a new organization based on this one.
tenants.cloneStructureOnlyDescription: Templates, form fields, document templates, cycles, accounts. No participants, events, protocols or users.
tenants.cloneFullDescription: Also participants, events, protocols, fines, todos, submissions and user access — e.g. for testing.
tenants.exportDescription: Creates a ZIP file to download, which can later be imported again in the admin panel as a new organization.
tenants.exportStructureOnlyDescription: Cycles, form fields, document templates, lists (definition only, no content), accounts, user roles and verified domains (incl. verification code).
tenants.exportStructureListsDescription: As above, plus the entries in the lists. Without participants/events - list entries that reference a participant or event are carried over without that reference.
tenants.exportFullDescription: Also participants, events, protocols, fines, todos and files (incl. photo gallery). Without Abgabebox.
tenants.exportFullAbgabeboxDescription: As above, plus Abgabebox configuration and uploaded files.
tenants.importDescription: Creates a new organization from a previously exported ZIP file.
tenants.mayTakeAMoment: This may take a moment depending on the file size.
tenants.importNotesDescription: The organization was imported, but some rows were skipped or adjusted:
tenants.deleteConfirmMessage: {participants} participants, {users} user accounts, and all protocols, events and files of this organization will be lost. This cannot be undone.
tenants.importedWithWarnings: {count, plural, one {Organization imported with # note} other {Organization imported with # notes}}

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Plans and modules assigned to organizations. All prices in CHF, excl. VAT.
pricing.nonBookablePlansFootnote: Non-bookable plans don't appear under "New organization", but can be assigned to individual organizations.
pricing.coreFeatureFootnote: Protocols, events, todos, participants and lists are core features included in every plan. Add-ons are booked per organization in the "Plan & subscription" tab of the organization settings.
pricing.storagePackagesFootnote: Add-on packages that organizations can book in addition to their plan quota in the "Storage" tab.
pricing.tenantsCanBookThemselves: Organizations can book this plan themselves.
pricing.onlyAdminCanAssign: This plan can only be assigned by the administration.
pricing.priceHelp: No fixed price? Just leave the fields empty. The monthly price is suggested from the yearly price with a 20% markup.
pricing.storageLimitHelp: The storage limit is applied to organizations as a quota, in addition to any booked storage packages.
pricing.notAssignedToAnyTenant: Not assigned to any organization yet.
pricing.name: Name
pricing.addonPriceHelp: Empty = not bookable as an add-on, only bundled via a plan.
pricing.packageSaveFailed: Storage package could not be saved
pricing.featuredOnWebsite: Highlight as “Most popular” on the website
pricing.featuredOnWebsiteHelp: At most one plan – saving removes the highlight from all other plans. Only bookable plans appear on the website.
